Treatment summary
Patient presented following a low-speed collision in a parking lot with complaints of neck and back pain. The reported
mechanism of injury is consistent with the type of impact described, and the presenting symptoms are plausible for
this kind of crash. Over the course of 28 visits, care included manual therapy, therapeutic exercise, and home
exercise instruction. The treatment followed a typical progression and was gradually reduced in frequency as the
patient's pain and range of motion improved. Imaging and physical examination findings clearly confirm the presence
of soft tissue injury to the cervical and lumbar regions. No prior injury to these body areas is known from the patient's
history. Billing records relfect single charges for each service rendered, with no repeated or duplicate entries. At
discharge the patient was improving, with remaining symptoms expected to resolve with continued home exercise.
